## RangeSelector interface

Select the objects at zero-based positions `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive).

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RangeSelector
```

## Remarks

The range is half-open, following JavaScript conventions: `{ start: 0, end: 10 }` selects the first ten objects. Both bounds are non-negative and `start <= end`<!-- -->; `start === end` is a valid, empty range. A range that extends past the end of the collection is detectable only when the reference is resolved, where it fails with an invalid-selection error.
